definitions.explanation: the activity of observing wild birds in their natural habitat, often as a hobby

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{鳥見|とりみ}に{行|い}く。
{早朝|そうちょう}の{鳥見|とりみ}は{気持|きも}ちがいい。
{鳥見|とりみ}を{始|はじ}めてから{双眼鏡|そうがんきょう}と{野鳥図鑑|やちょうずかん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: Since I started birdwatching, I've bought binoculars and a field guide to wild birds.

notes:
USAGE:
{鳥見|とりみ} is the native Japanese term for birdwatching. The English loanword バードウォッチング is also commonly used. {鳥見|とりみ} has a slightly more casual, colloquial feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥見|とりみ}に{行|い}く (to go birdwatching)
- {鳥見|とりみ}を{始|はじ}める (to start birdwatching)
- {鳥見|とりみ}スポット (birdwatching spot)

RELATED TERMS:
- {野鳥観察|やちょうかんさつ} (wild bird observation - more formal)
- {探鳥会|たんちょうかい} (birdwatching group/event)
